publicChronology.boundary: Every content signature exposed by the completed forward traversal received a redacted disposition. The count is a conservative public-surface content-signature count, not an exact lifetime post count; repeated identical posts may merge, and deleted, hidden, or unavailable records are outside the surface.

lifetimeMetricSnapshot.boundary: Mutable lifetime values from Meta Business Suite. They are not unique people, historical snapshots, stakeholder-group counts, reach, adoption, attendance, endorsement, causality, or impact.

nativeAnnualExports.productSurfaceDisagreement: Meta Business Suite labeled the Content lifetime as March 31, 2019 through July 14, 2026, while the annual export includes records beginning February 6, 2019. Both product-surface observations are retained.
nativeAnnualExports.boundary: The annual native exports establish exact Page-post IDs only for 2019 through 2021. They do not establish the full 2017 through 2021 public chronology or the complete lifetime deletion history.

controls.reconciliation: The 413 public-surface content signatures and 185 native-export post IDs overlap and must never be added together.

postedDestinationInventory.boundary: A posted destination establishes a routing action, not authorship, endorsement, readership, click-through, stakeholder response, adoption, causality, or impact.

authorshipAndCredit.userMemory: Jamie remembers that he was the predominant Page operator while other coalition members also published.
authorshipAndCredit.boundary: The native export does not identify the publishing administrator. Preserve shared coalition authorship and do not convert Jamie's memory into sole or verified Page authorship.

excluded: per-post reach, click, and engagement metrics
Google Docs and Drive working routes
publicSafety.creditBoundary: NYC Artist Coalition was collective work. Page publication does not assign authorship of every sentence, source, image, event, campaign, or outcome to Jamie or any single coalition member.
